{
  "intents": [
    {
      "name": "content_availability",
      "definition": "Requests or complaints regarding missing seasons, episodes, movies, or networks on Hulu.",
      "includes": "Messages asking when a specific season/episode will be on Hulu, or complaining that a show/network is missing.",
      "excludes": "Issues with technical playback errors or missing episodes due to a watchlist/app bug.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "When will season 3 be available on Hulu ??",
        "Why isn’t season 18 on Netflix or Hulu"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "account_and_billing_management",
      "definition": "Inquiries or issues related to Hulu account settings, membership plans, subscriptions, and billing charges.",
      "includes": "Questions about account sharing, unexpected charges, signing up, canceling, or changing subscription plans.",
      "excludes": "General app navigation complaints or streaming quality issues not directly related to billing.",
      "account_specific": true,
      "example_messages": [
        "Can you help me with a strange charge on my bank account from Hulu?",
        "How do I cancel crappy Hulu???"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "live_tv_streaming",
      "definition": "Questions, feature requests, or technical issues specifically concerning Hulu + Live TV and local channels/sports.",
      "includes": "Issues streaming live TV, local affiliate outages, channel guide complaints, and requests for specific live channels.",
      "excludes": "General on-demand video streaming issues or non-live app bugs.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "Hey why can't I stream live from my laptop anymore? For the past two days I get error playlist-1-FDC2F871.",
        "When will NBC live be available?"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "commercials_and_ads",
      "definition": "Complaints regarding ad repetition, ad volume, freezing caused by ads, or seeing ads on commercial-free plans.",
      "includes": "Complaints about repetitive commercials, loud ad volumes, ad-induced crashes, and getting ads despite paying for no-commercials.",
      "excludes": "General video buffering or playback errors unrelated to ad breaks.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "Why doesn’t Hulu ever have any variety to their commercials. I’ve seen the same Biz Markie Gap commercial like 1 million times.",
        "I pay for Hulu with no ads and I’m deadass watching an ad right now."
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "technical_support_and_errors",
      "definition": "Reports of error codes, app crashes, buffering, streaming failures, and troubleshooting steps tried by the user.",
      "includes": "Error codes (e.g., error 400, teal-8, 404), app freezing, casting failures, and device compatibility issues.",
      "excludes": "Feature requests, content availability questions, and billing issues.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "I’m still getting the same error code 400 I reset my internet and all",
        "My Hulu is not working. Worked last night. Other apps on my tv are fine."
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "app_interface_and_ux",
      "definition": "Feedback, complaints, or questions regarding the Hulu app interface, navigation, updates, and user experience.",
      "includes": "Complaints about the new interface, Roku/Apple TV app navigation, missing features like skip intro or download options, and UI layout changes.",
      "excludes": "Technical playback error codes or streaming downtime.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "I've been using the Hulu app on Roku for over a month now and I still hate the new interface.",
        "Your app on Apple TV is the worst UX ever."
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "watchlist_and_playback_tracking",
      "definition": "Issues where watchlists, history, new episode indicators, or autoplay fail to track correctly.",
      "includes": "Watchlist not updating, episodes marked incorrectly as new, episodes restarting from the beginning, or autoplay failing to advance.",
      "excludes": "Content completely missing from the platform library.",
      "account_specific": false,
      "example_messages": [
        "why is my watchlist not updating with new episodes?",
        "It’s not showing when there are new episodes and when you watch a new episode it continues to say it’s a new episode"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
